paragraphs: The X-Type 2.1 V6 uses the AJ20 — a 2.1-litre V6 petrol engine derived from the Ford Duratec family, shared with the Mondeo ST200 and other Ford models of the era. It was fitted from 2001 to 2009 across the X400 generation. The 2.1-litre sat alongside the 2.0-litre, 2.5-litre and 3.0-litre variants in the X-Type range, all using the same AJ-series V6 architecture. The 2.1 V6 was the entry-point petrol V6, offering a balance of refinement and performance that suited the X-Type's character. The X-Type was discontinued in 2009, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar X-Type 2.1 V6 Engine Compatibility The X-Type 2.1 V6 uses the AJ20 engine, part of the AJ-series V6 family shared across the X-Type's petrol range. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the X-Type 2.1 V6 from 2023 to present. The AJ20 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ20 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ20 rebuild.
